description: This file defines a SwiftUI-based wrapper that hosts arbitrary SwiftUI content within an AppKit NSMenuItem, enabling native Mac menu integration of SwiftUI views.

classes.name: MenuHostedItem
classes.description: A SwiftUI view that hosts arbitrary SwiftUI content within an AppKit NSView to embed in a menu item.

methods.name: makeNSView
methods.description: Creates an NSHostingView containing the rootView and applies sizing.

methods.name: updateNSView
methods.description: Updates the rootView of the existing NSHostingView and reapplies sizing.

methods.name: applySizing
methods.description: Adjusts the frame size of the hosting view based on the specified width and content fitting size.
